name: Status Row
description: Compact status and action row for lists and inspectors.
useWhen: The application needs this common UI pattern.
avoidWhen: A simpler native control already communicates the interaction.

accessibility.notes: Use semantic labels, visible focus, sufficient contrast and a keyboard-reachable interaction model.
keyboard: All interactive controls remain keyboard reachable.
aria: Prefer native semantics and explicit accessible names.
